room_rent.display: 1% of SI/day (SI ≥5L: 1% or Single AC room, higher)
room_rent.note: For SI < ₹5L: 1% of SI per day. For SI ≥ ₹5L: 1% of SI or Single Occupancy Standard AC Room, whichever is higher. Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken.

icu.note: For SI < ₹5L: 2% of SI per day. For SI ≥ ₹5L: actuals.

copayment.note: 10% co-payment on all admissible claims under base covers for persons with age of entry above 60 years.

sub_limits.note: Cataract surgery capped at 10% of Sum Insured or ₹50,000 per eye, whichever is lower.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 36 months of continuous coverage. Reducible via portability credit.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Table A (24 mo): cataract, hernia, cardiac surgeries, benign tumours, etc. Table B (36 mo): joint replacement, osteoarthritis, ARMD.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard permanent exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: CB increases by 10% per claim-free year up to maximum 20% of SI. Alternatively, policyholder may choose No Claim Discount (2.5%/yr up to 5% premium discount) instead.

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

pre_hosp.note: Pre- and post-hospitalisation combined subject to maximum 10% of SI.

post_hosp.note: Pre- and post-hospitalisation combined subject to maximum 10% of SI.

day_care.note: All day-care treatments as per definition covered under in-patient hospitalisation benefit.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation is a specific permanent exclusion (Clause IV.C.3). Home Care Treatment is covered only for epidemic/pandemic up to 10% of SI or ₹30,000, whichever is lower.

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment in recognised AYUSH hospitals/day care centres is covered under the operative clause as hospitalisation.

organ_donor.note: In-patient hospitalisation expenses for organ donor's harvesting procedure covered; pre/post-hosp and screening of donor excluded.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to ₹2,500 per event and ₹5,000 per policy period.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments including robotic surgery, oral chemotherapy, stem cell therapy (haematological), etc. covered as part of in-patient hospitalisation.

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable items listed in Annexure-1 are excluded. Sterilised gloves and some items payable in specific clinical contexts but general consumables not covered.

global_cover.note: Policy territorial limit is India only; all treatment must be taken in India.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim/policy contestable except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 30 days for annual/half-yearly/quarterly; 15 days for monthly instalment.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or portability/migration.

portability.note: Portability as per IRDAI guidelines; waiting period credits transferred.

notable_exclusions.display: Domiciliary hospitalisation, OPD treatment, all sleep disorders, external congenital anomalies, hearing aids, multi-focal/toric lenses, RFQMR/ECP/EECP therapies

optional_riders.display: Daily Cash Allowance on Hospitalisation (₹500–₹2,000/day based on SI)
